fusions.name: Searing Coil
fusions.desc: Wraps an arm around the target for 6 damage, setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slowing it by 25% for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Burning Ink Bank
fusions.desc: Vents a bank of ink 5 tiles long ahead of you and lights it for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it and sets that enemy [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Smoulder Screen
fusions.desc: Vents a cloud of smoke that veils you for 5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Flash-Boil Reflex
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, a jet of steam from your siphon scalds the nearest enemy within 3 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
